cases.label: weighted_salary
cases.question: For Yale, calculate the weighted average nine-month salary of full-time nonmedical instructional staff across professor, associate professor and assistant professor ranks in the 2024–25 release. Weight each rank's nine-month average salary by its nine-month staff count. Exclude all other ranks and the all-ranks total.
cases.independent_sql: SELECT SUM(1.0*SA09MAT*SA09MCT)/SUM(SA09MCT) FROM SAL2024_IS WHERE UNITID=130794 AND ARANK IN (1,2,3)
cases.message: For Yale University (2024-25), Weighted average 9-month salary, professor/associate/assistant (weighted by 9-month staff count): 239,023.53. The reporting period and source definitions are available below.

cases.label: joined_weighted_tuition
cases.question: Calculate one combined weighted mean of Yale and Harvard's out-of-state undergraduate tuition for academic year 2024–25, weighted by each institution's fall 2024 total undergraduate headcount. Use the tuition amount and enrollment headcount from their respective source tables; explicitly compare these different reporting periods.
cases.independent_sql: SELECT SUM(1.0*t.TUITION3*e.EFTOTLT)/SUM(e.EFTOTLT) FROM Cost1_2024 t JOIN EF2024A e USING(UNITID) WHERE t.UNITID IN (130794,166027) AND e.EFALEVEL=2
